'''Kirukan''' was a fabled warrior Queen from [[Aramaelle]].

== History ==
Legend says that she beheaded a [[False Dragon]] with her sword and had two sons to another man who could [[channel]]. [[Birgitte Silverbow]] said that Kirukan's temper was like that of a boar caught in briars.{{ref/book|5|48}}

==Legacy==
Years later her sword, which has a two-handed hilt and may have been [[Power-wrought]], is in the possession of Queen [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu]] of [[Kandor]].{{ref/book|8|p}}
